purpose: Independent manual photograph measurements for the six user-specified GT turret models; display stands are excluded from authored models.

sourcePhotos.role: Two-row common-scale lineup; first row is single500, twin200, quad500, quad200, then existing ion sphere
Oblique lineup; light models are at the right side of the photograph
Side details: upper left single200, upper right twin200Fast, lower left single500, lower right twin200
Open single antiaircraft gun mechanism reference for single200
Enclosed high-angle twin gunhouse mechanism reference for twin200

coordinateConvention.pixels: Original image pixels, origin at upper left; bounds are approximate inclusive extrema.
coordinateConvention.model: Metres; +X is barrel forward, +Y is mounting normal/up, +Z is lateral.
coordinateConvention.physicalDimensions: WholeLength is the rest-pose barrel-axis envelope. Ball diameter is the full physical sphere, including its embedded lower third.

measurementMethod: Visible silhouette and feature endpoints were read manually from the supplied photographs and checked with a non-black pixel mask. Dark painted edges and photographed perspective do not define exact CAD extrema. Targets are rounded to 0.1 m; they are not a power-density scaling law.

anchor.note: The lower-right existing eight-barrel Imperial turret is the established forty-metre anchor.

crossCheck.note: The lower-left existing single40 agrees with the octuple scale to within about 2 percent.

photo1.method: Rounded common working scale between the two established model anchors.

photo3.method: Transfer the same horizontal twin200 silhouette between photo1 (approximately156 px) and photo3 (approximately572 px).
photo3.note: The upper-right model is the user-designated vertical rapid twin200, not the 500 GT quad.

single500.construction: Small complete ball turret. Its sphere and barrel aim together, with the lower one-third of the diameter embedded into the host.
single500.measurementNotes: The pitched silhouette is not a horizontal rest-length measurement. Photo3 sphere diameter is approximately174 px; barrel tip to sphere center is approximately360 px, plus the sphere radius for the back extent.

barrelProfile.rootMeaning: Visible first long narrow-shaft neck after the enlarged recoil/breech, not the hidden complete assembly root or wheel center.
barrelProfile.samplingMethod: Isolated contiguous foreground interval at60/255 maximum RGB intensity along a perpendicular to the photographed axis, with boundaries rounded to half a pixel. Neighboring barrels are excluded from the interval. Compression and antialiasing uncertainty is at least one pixel; no exact CAD bore diameter is inferred.

twin200.construction: Horizontal left/right twin in an enclosed high-angle gunhouse. The first and third photos establish proportions; photo5 establishes armored case and gun-port detailing.

secondBarrelAxisPixels.note: Lower trace is a perspective/elevation cross-check. A few pixels of projected horizontal offset do not indicate a native fore/aft barrel stagger.

geometryDistinctions.note: These are different intervals. Moving the source case and wheel must not turn complete assembly length into a thin-shaft length.

closeupMuzzlePairs.interpretation: The upper and lower tips in each column align in the controlling oblique close-up. The500 GT quad rebuild uses equal native rootX and tipX for both heights. Only twin200Fast is intentionally staggered.

caseProfileMeasurements.note: The lower armor case excludes the raised roof/rear machinery. The complete assembly silhouette height must not be applied uniformly to the source armor case; the wheel diameter is an independent feature.

caseNarrowing.method: clip both source STL lateral wings and cap the resulting actual cross-sections; translate each complete external gun assembly inward
caseNarrowing.interpretation: The cut planes follow the inner edges of the two red marked regions in the dimensioned native top view.

quad200.construction: Uniformly smaller derivative of the current external-mount twin40 gunhouse; replace its two tubes with two central-height tubes per external circular mount, four total.
quad200.measurementNotes: The two visible side-profile tubes are elevated. Their vertical projection is not the rest-pose body height; width and height follow the scaled twin40 body.

latestReferencePhotos.role: Controlling common-scale barrel length and diameter reference for the six labeled GT models; the three additional unassigned guns at the top are outside this implementation.
Controlling500 GT quad construction: large circular mechanisms remain external; four separate slim barrels in two vertical pairs.
Controlling200 GT quad construction: paired slim barrels on each external circular mount; cylindrical muzzle tips without a conspicuous flared collar.
User-marked top view: remove the two flared lateral wings from the STL case, narrow the case and move the complete external gun mechanisms inward; retain the measured barrel profiles.

latestBarrelAnchor.note: These are the same two established lower-row physical anchors as the earlier sheet, now shifted down by approximately232 pixels.
